legacy_pipeline_config.text:
# Frozen existing spatial-B weights. No training or hyperparameter search.
seed: 7
cpu_threads: 1
dt: 0.01
data_directory: data/mujoco_soft_pilot/pilot_001
checkpoint: outputs/soft_spatial_encoding_ablation/run_001/B/checkpoint.pt
output_root: outputs/contact_pipeline_validation
splits:
  train: [center_shallow, center_deep]
  validation: [left_shallow, left_deep]
  control: [no_contact]
calibration:
  trajectories: [center_shallow, center_deep]
  phase_ids: [1, 2]
  objective: nonnegative_per_contact_normal_force_least_squares
initial_material:
  normal_stiffness: 800.0  # N/m; replaced by center-only calibration
  normal_damping: 12.0    # N s/m; replaced by center-only calibration
  tangent_damping: 4.0    # N s/m; fixed, no search
  friction_coefficient: 0.3
material_features: [1.0, 0.3, 0.2, 0.3]  # Existing training normalization, NOT stiffness
sphere_radius_m: 0.012
# Gaussian scale remains half nearest rest-node spacing = 0.005 m.
# Iso-radius .2*.005 = .001 m matches the known MuJoCo collision skin.
# Surface-node balls do not fill triangle faces; detection errors are measured.
gaussian_surface_level: 0.2
contact_neighborhood_radius_m: 0.02
rollout:
  horizons: [5, 10, 20]
  # No data-driven window selection: pressing, hold, unload, separation, recovery.
  start_frames: [70, 110, 140, 150, 170, 210]
  update: constant_acceleration_from_displacement_residual
  external_input: recorded_current_indenter_motion_and_command

integration_config.text:
experiment_date: "2026-10-29"
seed: 7
cpu_threads: 1
base_config: configs/validate_contact_surface.yaml
sampling_config: configs/audit_contact_sampling.yaml
baseline_run: outputs/contact_sampling_audit/run_001
output_root: outputs/adaptive_contact_integration
integration:
  orders: [4, 8, 16, 32]
  relative_tolerance: 0.0001
  area_absolute_tolerance_m2: 1.0e-18
  elastic_absolute_tolerance_m3: 1.0e-26
  damping_absolute_tolerance_m3_s: 1.0e-22
  max_depth: 12
  max_intervals: 512
reference_orders: [128, 256]
reference_trajectory_frames: [70, 110, 150]
flat_plane_depths_m: [0.00005, 0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001]
flat_plane_robot_speed_m_s: 0.01
stress_depths_m: [0.0000001, 0.000001, 0.00001, 0.00005]
stress_regions: [top, edge, corner]
benchmark:
  trajectory: center_deep
  frames: [70, 110, 150]
  warmup: 2
  repetitions: 10
acceptance:
  max_reference_relative_error: 0.001
  max_reference_order_difference: 0.0001
  max_closed_form_relative_error: 0.001
# Accuracy/positivity checks, not force fitting or validation-based density search.
